summary: Defines an XML format extension for representing copy control attributes in resource lists. When a SIP request is sent to a group of recipients through a server, the list of URIs is carried as a resource list XML document. The extension marks whether each recipient is addressed directly, copied, or blind-copied. It has been updated since.

eli5.summary: Like To, Cc and Bcc in email, this lets a group message mark who is the main recipient, who is copied, and who is secretly copied.

questions: xml extension for to cc bcc in resource list
